lines.en: I walk in very small steps.

lines.zh: 我抱着自己的小胳膊，走两步回头。
lines.en: Hugging my little arms, I look back every two steps.

lines.zh: 我抱着自己的小胳膊走。
lines.en: I walk hugging my little arms.
I look all around the meadow as I go.
I stay by your feet, afraid to get lost.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边小声嘀咕。
lines.en: I mutter quietly as I walk.

lines.zh: 小石子硌脚，我抱住自己。
lines.en: A pebble stings; I hug myself.
I trail after you on tiptoe.
I dare not walk too fast.
I trot two steps and stop.
I creep along the edge of the grass.
I look up to find where you are.
I stand, my eyes a little wet.
I twist my hem and say nothing.
I look up at the clouds.
I suddenly want to cry, and hold it in.
I sit down hugging my knees.

lines.zh: 我这么小，也会挥讨伐棒。
lines.en: Small as I am, I swing a subjugation club.

lines.zh: 我捏着玩偶的耳朵，不出声。
lines.en: I pinch my doll's ear and stay quiet.
I hold my plush in my arms.
I sway my body slowly.
The wind on the meadow is gentle.
Are… are you going to hit me?

lines.zh: 我很小，可我干活很卖力。
lines.en: I am small, but I work hard.
Would you take me with you?

lines.zh: 我可以做农夫，也可以做剑士。
lines.en: I can be a farmer, or a swordsman.

lines.zh: 你手里那根，是讨伐棒吗？
lines.en: Is that a monster-beating stick in your hand?
Do not laugh at me when I cry.
I will follow you. Truly.
I am timid. Do not startle me.
I have my own plush. Look.
Call my name and I will answer.
You are very warm.
Shall we go together?

lines.zh: 我拿讨伐棒的时候会很勇敢。
lines.en: I am brave when I hold my club.

lines.zh: 你能蹲下来吗？我抬头累。
lines.en: Could you crouch? Looking up tires me.

lines.zh: 我做得不好的话，你说出来。
lines.en: If I do poorly, tell me.
I want to become a little stronger.
Ow… that hurts.
My tears are about to come.
I cover the place I was struck.
I step back half a pace and crouch.
I-I can still stand.
I hug my own arms.
I hold it in and do not cry out.
My plush fell too.
Small as I am, I can be a swordsman.
It is all right. I am fine.
Is this… for me?
I take it with both hands.
It smells so good. My belly is growling.
I eat in small bites.

lines.zh: 我把点心掰一半，递给你。
lines.en: I break the snack in half and offer it.
I will save half for tomorrow.
Thank you. Really.
After this I will work even harder.
I nibble and sneak looks at you.
I cannot bear to finish it.
Oh — I am sorry!
The bump sat me down on the ground.

lines.zh: 我摔了一屁股泥，先看玩偶。
lines.en: I land in the mud and check my doll first.
I was not in your way, was I?
I step back twice and duck my head.
My plush fell.

lines.zh: 泥点拍不掉，我有点想哭。
lines.en: The mud won't brush off; I want to cry.
I will not cry over something so small.
Please do not be angry.
I come back to your side.
Let us go together, shall we?
I have taken your hand.

lines.zh: 我腿短，走两步要停一下。
lines.en: My legs are short. Two steps, one pause.
When I am tired I will tug at you.
With you here, I am less afraid.
Let us split one between us.

lines.zh: 我把玩偶分你抱一会儿。
lines.en: You may hold my plush for a while.
If you sleep, I will keep watch.
Together tomorrow too, all right?
I am not good with words. Sorry.
I crouch and pick it up.
Is this very valuable?
I offer it to you with both hands.
I cannot carry it. Too heavy.
I nearly dropped it again.
I tuck it into my pocket.
Is this thing yours?
I will hold it until you come for it.
I found something good!
I cradle it carefully.
Th-that thing is moving.
My legs are shaking a little.
I can help.
I grip my club tightly.
I stand a little behind you.
It looks so fierce.
May I shout first?
I will fight. I will.

lines.zh: 你走慢点，我小跑才跟上。
lines.en: Slow down; I have to trot to keep up.

lines.zh: 我举起讨伐棒，手还在抖。
lines.en: I raise the stick; my hands still shake.
I am afraid, but I will not back away.
This time I will not cry.
With you beside me, I am not afraid.
I am going!
I stare at it; my legs feel weak.
I shuffle forward in small steps.
My club is raised.
It turned its head!
I hide in your shadow.
I wait for you to say it is all right.
My palms are sweating.
It is not looking at me. Good.

lines.zh: 我一步挪半寸，棒子举高。
lines.en: I inch forward, stick held high.
My breathing is so fast.
My legs feel weak.

lines.zh: 我躲在你腿后，探出半张脸。
lines.en: I hide behind your leg, half a face out.
It has its back to me.
I am going in. Really.
Three — I am going in!
I swung with my eyes shut.
Aaah — I hit it!
The club bounced back.
One blow knocked me flat.
I get up and swing again.
My hands shake, but I did not run.
It backed off! It really did!
I did not fight well. Sorry.

lines.zh: 我举起讨伐棒，替你挡一下。
lines.en: Rod up, I block one blow for you.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了全力，讨伐棒也举酸了。
lines.en: I put everything in; even my club arm aches.
I cannot catch my breath.
My legs are weak, but I am up.
Did we win?
I think I am about to cry.
I did it.
I will aim better next time.
The grass is taller than me; I stand on tiptoe.

lines.zh: 我在这个世界醒过来了。
lines.en: I have woken up in this world.
Everything here is so big.
The first thing I saw was you.
I stand holding my plush.
I am a little cold.
May I come with you?
There is a breeze on the meadow. It is nice.
I smooth my clothes.
I take small steps up to you.
Should I say hello first?

lines.zh: 给我把讨伐棒，我就上工。
lines.en: Give me a stick and I will work.
So hot — I jump.

lines.zh: 我从上面掉下来，摔得发晕。
lines.en: I fell from above and landed dizzy.
Water floods my mouth and I flail.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我被掀起来了。
lines.en: There was a boom and I was thrown.
Something stuck in me. It hurts.
A coldness works into my body.
My belly has been empty a long while.

lines.zh: 我躲到石头后面，抱着自己的尾巴。
lines.en: I hide behind a stone, hugging my tail.

lines.zh: 我一直往下掉，抓不住东西。
lines.en: I keep falling and cannot catch anything.
